_schema.note: Curated to federal-health-IT-relevant agencies. Each entry includes the official forecast URL plus our read on data accessibility (HTML-only, downloadable, or API). Every URL below was fetched live on 2026-09-10; where an agency's old forecast page has moved or gone dark, the entry says so and points at where the forecast actually lives now.

agencies.format: Governmentwide FCO tool (filter Agency = Department of Veterans Affairs). Searchable, CSV export, JSON behind the UI
agencies.cadence: Continuous; VA rows updated as recently as 2026-09-04
agencies.mmt_note: VA publishes its forecast into the governmentwide Forecast of Contracting Opportunities tool that GSA hosts (688 VA rows on 2026-09-10, 607 of them from the Technology Acquisition Center). VA's own query tool at vendorportal.ecms.va.gov/eVP/FCO/fco.aspx is FY2026-scoped, interactive only, and was last reviewed 05/07/2026. The old OSDBU acquisition page (va.gov/osdbu/acquisition/) now returns 403 in a browser too.

agencies.format: Downloadable Excel (Long Range Acquisition Forecast) linked from Working with DHA
agencies.cadence: Annual; the posted file is still the FY2025 forecast (workbook modified 2025-05-22)
agencies.mmt_note: dha.mil sits behind a bot challenge, so the workbook only downloads in a real browser. As of 2026-09-10 the link still serves the FY25 LRAF; no FY26 or FY27 forecast has been posted. Map any DHA line to the post-reorg PAE that will own it.

agencies.agency: Department of Health and Human Services (all OpDivs)
agencies.format: SBCX search interface (mySBCX moved to osdbu.hhs.gov). Filterable by OpDiv and contracting office; JSON export behind the UI
agencies.cadence: Continuous, but OpDivs refresh unevenly: CMS, IHS and FDA carry FY26/FY27 rows; CDC, NIH and the Office of the Secretary (ASA/PSC) still show FY24/FY25 dates
agencies.mmt_note: HHS's unified small-business forecast across CMS, NIH, ARPA-H, CDC, FDA, IHS and ONC. 5,375 published rows on 2026-09-10, 3,928 of them IHS. Filter by OpDiv; NIH's own OAMP page points here as the NIH Procurement Forecast.

agencies.format: Downloadable Excel (Forecast of Opportunities), updated around the first of every month
agencies.cadence: Monthly; current file is dated 1 September 2026 (51 rows)
agencies.mmt_note: The old forecast-contracting-opportunities URL is gone; the workbook now lives under Work With Us > Business Resources > Contract Opportunities. CMS also mirrors a subset into HHS SBCX.

agencies.format: Forecast Tool on the Acquisition Gateway (replaced forecast.gsa.gov, which no longer resolves). Searchable, CSV export
agencies.cadence: Continuous; 9,219 rows governmentwide on 2026-09-10, 391 of them GSA's own
agencies.mmt_note: GSA's own rows cover FAS, PBS and OCIO buys plus assisted acquisitions GSA runs for other agencies (HHS OIG cloud, HHS MSO). Governmentwide vehicles (OASIS+, Alliant 3, MAS) show up here before SAM.gov.

agencies.agency: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health
agencies.format: HTML program announcements (no procurement forecast); solicitations posted on SAM.gov
agencies.cadence: Rolling; new programs announced throughout the year
agencies.mmt_note: ARPA-H does not publish a forecast and has no rows in HHS SBCX. The arpa-h.gov/research-funding URL we linked in May now 404s; program announcements live under Explore Funding. Set a recurring check here rather than on the acquisition.gov hub.

agencies.format: Web app with structured filters and CSV export
agencies.mmt_note: DHS APFS is the gold-standard federal forecast UX. Not health-relevant directly, but worth watching as the format other agencies emulate.
Each Service medical department (Army MEDCOM, AFMS, BUMED) maintains its own forecast linked from the DoD hub.
